AnilKumar Gurreddy

Email: anilkumargurreddy@gmail.com Phone: +91 8374379758 Location: Hyderabad, India LinkedIn Profile: Anilkumar Gurreddy | LinkedIn

Professional Summary Software Engineer with 2.5+ years of experience designing and developing scalable distributed backend systems using Node.js, NestJS, ReactJS, TypeScript, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Redis. Experienced in building multi-tenant microservices, REST APIs, API Gateways, WebSocket-based real-time systems, and event-driven architectures. Hands-on expertise in Keycloak, JWT, RBAC, RabbitMQ, BullMQ, Docker, CI/CD, caching, distributed locking, retries, throttling, circuit breakers, and system design. Built enterprise solutions including an AI-powered interview platform and a real-time IoT asset tracking platform.

Core Skills  Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Java  Core JavaScript: Async/Await, Promises, Closures, Event Loop, Execution Context, ES6+  Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express.js  Frontend: React.js, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+)  Architecture: Microservices, Distributed Systems, REST APIs, API Gateway, WebSockets,

System Design

Databases: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB aggregation pipelines, Indexing,

bulkWrite, Transactions, performance tuning

Messaging: RabbitMQ, BullMQ  Security: Keycloak, JWT, RBAC  DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes (Basics), AWS (EKS, S3 basics), Git, CI/CD  Tools: Postman, Swagger  Concepts: Caching, Distributed Locking (Redlock), Rate Limiting, Retries, Circuit Breakers, Async Processing, Prompt Engineering

Professional Experience

Backend Engineer | Dot AI | Apr 2024 – July 2026  Designed and developed 10+ scalable multi-tenant microservices using NestJS and

MongoDB behind an API Gateway.

Optimized database query performance through indexing and transaction management.  Implemented Keycloak authentication with JWT and RBAC.

Built resiliency mechanisms including retries, throttling, and circuit breakers.  Developed backend services for real-time IoT asset tracking using Wiliot asset tags, bridges, and gateways. Integrated Pricer Electronic Shelf Labels (ESL) for inventory synchronization. Implemented Redis caching and Redlock-based distributed locking.

  Participated in scalable distributed system design and fault-tolerant architecture discussions.

Software Engineer | Skill IQ | Oct 2023 – Mar 2024  Developed backend services for an AI-powered interview platform.  Built scalable REST APIs and multi-tenant microservices using NestJS, MongoDB, and

PostgreSQL.

Created ChatGPT prompt-engineering workflows to extract skills from job descriptions

and generate interview questions.

Developed WebSocket-based real-time communication services.  Implemented asynchronous workflows using RabbitMQ and BullMQ.  Worked with DevOps teams on Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, and production deployments.

Developed responsive user interfaces using ReactJS, HTML5, CSS3 and JS, React Hooks

(useState, useEffect) for state and lifecycle management.

Worked with EKS and Kubernetes basics, including Pods, Deployments, Services,

ConfigMaps, and Secrets.

Key Projects

AI-Powered Interview Platform Built backend microservices, REST APIs, WebSocket services, and AI-driven prompt- engineering workflows for automated candidate assessment and interview generation.

Tech Stack: Node.js, NestJS, ReactJS, HTML5, CSS3, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, BullMQ, Docker, ChatGPT

Real-Time IoT Asset Tracking Platform Developed distributed backend services to process IoT telemetry, asset tracking, inventory movement, and ESL integration with scalable microservices.

Tech Stack: Node.js, NestJS, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Redlock, Keycloak, Docker, RabbitMQ

Education Bachelor of Technology (Computer Science & Engineering) TKR College of Engineering and Technology 2022
